title: WorkOrder lifecycle contract
x-rules: pipeline_status is the orchestration display state; backend_status/status is the WorkOrder fact-source state.
A newly created open WorkOrder maps to pipeline_status=waiting_dispatch; it must not be reported as waiting_repair.
A WorkOrder may close only after status=completed and a passed device-recovery verification.
Memory learning requires status=closed, non-empty repair_feedback, and a passed device-recovery verification.
